node.title: Re: -bash: use
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Could you give us enough information to reproduce the issue, like what the top of your script looks like and how you're running it? See also [id://1177642|SSCCE] and [id://174051]

Just a guess: Does your script start with #!/usr/bin/perl or similar, or not? Are you running your script via perl scriptname.pl, ./scriptname.pl, or maybe even . scriptname.pl?
